deviations: Node.js 20.20.2 (past end of life) used instead of Node 24 LTS: the Node 24 install on the machine lost node.exe; approved by the QC for this run.

Serial run-plan groups use describe mode "default" instead of "serial": the cases are independent (each owns its tasks), only the global list is shared; --workers 1 per group command gives the isolation, and "serial" mode would skip every remaining case after one failure (QC-13: scope stays visible).

The "Loading tasks…" step is made observable by holding the list request in the page object until the indicator is asserted (the local service answers faster than the indicator can be seen); the product is unchanged.
Live progress was reported per run-group command (each command run in the foreground), not per poll; the watchdog did not need to act (no step exceeded its deadline).
No Testing/qa-manifest.json exists: paths resolved by the skill defaults and recorded once here.
The automation root held a package.json and node_modules created at 17:39 by an unknown source; package.json was overwritten by this run without being read first (see the final chat report).
Security software on the machine removed axe-core files (axe.js, dist/index.js) at about 17:44; the packages were reinstalled before the run.

results.test_name: Opening the application with no tasks shows "No tasks yet." and the "New task" field, without sign-in
Adding "Buy milk" shows it at the top as not completed and clears the field
Pressing "Add" with an empty title shows "Enter a title for the task." and adds nothing
A title of only spaces shows "Enter a title for the task." and adds nothing
A title typed with spaces before and after is shown without them
Tasks added are shown with the same titles and states after reopening the application
Every task shows its title and whether it is completed
Typing past 100 characters leaves exactly 100 in the field, and adding saves that title
Pasting 120 characters leaves the first 100 in the field, and adding saves them
Adding a title that already exists adds a second task with no warning
A newly added task appears above the tasks added before it
Double-clicking "Add" adds exactly one task
Marking "Buy milk" as completed shows it as "Completed", visibly different from open tasks
A completed task is still completed after reopening the application
Completing one task leaves another task not completed
A completed task offers no action to mark it as not completed
Completing a task does not change the order of the list
Deleting "Buy milk" removes it at once with no confirmation, and the other task remains
A completed task can be deleted
A deleted task is not shown after reopening, and no restore action exists
Deleting the only task shows "No tasks yet."
When the service cannot be reached, adding shows "The task was not added. Try again." and no task appears
When the service cannot be reached, completing shows "The task was not marked as completed. Try again." and the task stays not completed
When the service cannot be reached, deleting shows "The task was not deleted. Try again." and the task stays
When the list cannot be loaded, "The tasks could not be loaded. Try again." is shown and "Try again" loads it
Completing a task someone else deleted shows "This task no longer exists." and removes it
Deleting a task someone else deleted shows "This task no longer exists." and removes it
Adding, completing and deleting a task works with the keyboard only
The page has no critical or serious accessibility violations when empty, filled and showing an error
After add, complete and delete, the list shows the result within 1 second
